value.rationale: The sign of a canonical energy-maximizing signed mass is geometrically meaningful. The theorem shows that negative mass need not correspond to interior points: an open interval for every n>=4 makes all 2n sites exposed while half receive negative mass. Its exact root and the sharp n^-2 coexistence-window scale provide a natural structural and asymptotic classification, not a routine isolated computation.
